description:
Aggregate the work that gives configuration one assembly from bytes, removes the executor's disk-backed caches, and converges gate presets and gate evidence capture on captured images.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure function assembles `JitConfig` from source bytes for filesystem loading and image capture, and `ConfigurationDeclarations` duplicates no assembled field.
- [hard] REQ-02: The executor holds no disk-backed configuration, rules or namespace cache; read paths take declarations from a captured image, and each mutation attempt parses its declarations once per captured image.
- [hard] REQ-03: Gate presets are read as storage-supplied bytes keyed by the gate-presets path through one pure catalog, with no preset file I/O outside storage.
- [hard] REQ-04: Gate evaluation and precheck capture evidence through one function that enforces the prompt size limit, and each evaluation resolves its inputs once per captured image.


## Rulings

- Sol checkpoint review finding 3, in part, is out of scope (steward ruling, just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): verdict digests that read live files (`gate_check.rs` ~920, `gate_execution.rs` ~410) stay as they are. An exec checker runs on the working tree, so its digest must fingerprint the live inputs it consumes. REQ-04 covers only that each evaluation resolves its inputs once per captured image (task `a869900b`).


- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08) on the sol re-checkpoint review at `cea13616e`: finding 1 → task `e5d7bc11`; finding 2 → folded into `86a183c2` (REQ-01, REQ-02 amended); finding 3 → task `6b22ce6d`, after `86a183c2`.
title: Configuration and gate declarations come from captured images
